app.name: Collab Board
app.tagline: Real-time tasks, without the refresh button.
app.description: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui are wired up. Shared Zod schemas from @repo/shared and UI components from @repo/ui are connected.
